title: SQL Statement in AL Profiles
summary: SQL Statement collection in AL performance profiles, available in Business Central 2025 Wave 2 (version 27), allows developers to see which SQL queries run during profiled code execution in sampling mode. This capability helps identify database-related performance issues faster by showing the exact SQL statements executed within methods.
key_points: SQL statements are now visible in AL performance profiles through the in-client profiler, showing individual queries executed during method execution
SQL collection works only in sampling mode, not instrumentation mode, limiting consistency of profiling data
Available through in-client performance profiler, scheduled profiles, and snapshot debugging in Visual Studio Code
Results can be viewed in VS Code by opening .alcpuprofile files or imported into the web client Performance Profiler tool
features: Time Spent by Application Object view

quotes.text: SQL Statement collection in AL profiles is enabled only when tracing in sampling mode and not in instrumentation mode.
quotes.why_it_matters: Understanding the limitation helps developers know when they can use this feature and plan profiling strategies accordingly

quotes.text: In the Method Name you will see that there are the SQL Statement collected and not just the Method itself, as in previous versions
quotes.why_it_matters: This demonstrates the key improvement - developers can now drill down from methods to see the actual SQL queries executed

quotes.text: A real nice touch that will be helpful in pinpointing database access related performance issues in shorter time.
quotes.why_it_matters: Captures the practical value of the feature for developers troubleshooting performance problems
